siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Les Morainières
siblings.summary: Seven character-rich stays within ~25 km of Les Morainières — chef's own guesthouse with a free shuttle is the obvious pick; châteaux, wine-domain B&Bs and a canal coaching inn back it up.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Les Morainières
siblings.summary: What to actually do around Jongieux — wine cellars, Lac du Bourget cruises, Aix-les-Bains spa, hikes from a vineyard loop to Mont Granier, the petite Venise at Chanaz, and a half-day in Chambéry — all within 30 km of the restaurant.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Les Morainières
siblings.summary: The 30 km bubble around Les Morainières is a tech-conference desert — one university cybersecurity lecture and a closed solar-R&D workshop in April 2026 are the only fixtures; everything else is small Chambéry meetups.
